errors.evidence: The horizontal axis does not have a label. The text "实体数目" (Number of Entities) is the title of the chart, not an axis label.
The categories are listed vertically from top to bottom, not horizontally from left to right. This phrasing is incorrect for a horizontal bar chart.
The description refers to the values as "近似值" (approximate values), but the chart provides exact integer values labeled next to each bar.
